overt.name: 明征
overt.desc: 谁都看得见；酒馆老板会把它算进价钱。

subtle.name: 隐征
subtle.desc: 需近看：队中有感知 14 以上者或祠堂 2 级才认得出。老板常常看漏。

latent.name: 潜征
latent.desc: 携因而不显：只有祠堂验血能看见。

awakened.name: 觉醒律
awakened.desc: 河图之因呈显性，但要立下功勋才会在颈侧显纹：伯爵及以上，或受「旗誓」「冠线」荣衔者，携因即显。子嗣继承的是因，不是功——每一代都要重新打出来。
awakened.punnett: 携因(R/-) × 无因：子代 50% 携因；觉醒与否看本人勋位。R/R × 任意：子代 100% 携因。

dose.name: 剂量律
dose.desc: 朔因不完全显性：一份显弦朔瞳（瞳缘一弯银弦），两份显全朔瞳（瞳孔外整圈银环）。强弱直接写在眼睛里。

threshold.name: 阈值律
threshold.desc: 玉缕由多基因「玉值」决定：子代 = 父母均值 + 随机(σ0.06) + 15% 向本人血统均值回归。玉值 ≥0.72 显玉缕，≥0.48 显玉泽，≥0.40 为潜。牒外通婚把玉值拉回平均。
threshold.punnett: 非孟德尔：用正态近似。玉牒 × 玉牒均值约 0.80（≈91% 显玉缕）；玉牒 × 汀洲约 0.50（几乎只剩玉泽）。

dominant.name: 显性律
dominant.desc: 灯丝因完全显性，一份即显；琉光为次一级等位，被灯丝遮盖。显性让灯丝在港口泛滥，于是灯座只能拍卖。
dominant.punnett: 灯丝/无 × 无/无：50% 灯丝。灯丝/灯丝 × 任意：100%。

recessive.name: 隐性律
recessive.desc: 等位序列 霜梢眉 > 无 > 霜睫：霜睫须两份才显；霜梢眉为贵胤小征，显性。携者外表无异，只有祠堂验血能看见。

y_linked.name: 父传子律
y_linked.desc: 冰裂纹随父系 Y 而行：冰裂之父的每个儿子都显冰裂，女儿永不承。一代无子，窑火即冷，无法从女儿那里复燃。
y_linked.punnett: 冰裂父：儿子 100% · 女儿 0%。母亲不影响结果。冰裂之子若其父无冰裂，必是「冒窑」。

x_dominant.name: 父传女律
x_dominant.desc: 潮痕随 X 而行且为显性：潮痕男子传给全部女儿、不传儿子；一份潮痕的母亲传给一半子女。盐线为次一级等位。
x_dominant.punnett: 潮痕父 × 无母：女 100% · 男 0%。潮痕母(杂合) × 无父：子女各 50%。

penetrance.name: 外显律
penetrance.desc: 峡眉因显性，但只有六成携者真的眉被劈开；其余四成眉形完整，称「藏钢」，照样把因传给子嗣。是否外显在出生时定下，终身不变。
penetrance.punnett: 峡眉/无 × 无：50% 携因 → 约 30% 显峡眉、20% 藏钢。

complement.name: 互补律
complement.desc: 三台与四辅是两种各自显性的小征；同一人兼得二者，才合成北斗七星痣。东虹只有三台、西虹只有四辅——两家必须世代联姻。
complement.punnett: 三台/三台 × 四辅/四辅：100% 七星。七星 × 七星：七星 50% · 三台 25% · 四辅 25%。

maternal.name: 母传律
maternal.desc: 萤光只经母系：母亲的萤值传给每个孩子，每代随机漂移(σ0.07)；父亲一分不传。萤值 ≥0.66 显萤斑，≥0.36 显萤痕。萤子发光，却注定无后可传。
maternal.punnett: 萤母 × 任意父：子女萤值 ≈ 母值。萤子 × 任意母：子女萤值 = 母值，与他无关。

age_awakened.name: 年觉律
age_awakened.desc: 等位显性，但要到位点写明的年龄才在脸上显出来。此前是潜征，祠堂能验到因，肖像不画。
age_awakened.punnett: 显因 × 无：子代约 50% 携因；未到龄不显。纯合 × 无：子代全部携因，到龄才显。

pureblood.name: 纯血律
pureblood.desc: 稀有隐性。两份纯血等位，并且本国的王族冕征已经显出来，才出现那一个额外表情。冕征未显时纯血只是潜征。
pureblood.punnett: 纯血杂合 × 杂合：约 25% 纯合。纯合是否看得见，还要看本冕是否已显。

river_chart.desc: 左颈下方银紫色的细密分支纹，像平原的河网图。携因者须立功方显。
river_chart.prompt: a fine silver-violet branching line pattern on the left side of the neck below the jaw, like a river-delta map drawn in hairline ink, a natural skin pattern rather than a tattoo, the collar open on the left so the neck shows

chart_trunk.desc: 左颈一道淡银紫的细线，是河图的主干、没有支流。
chart_trunk.prompt: a single faint silver-violet hairline running down the left side of the neck

eclipse_full.desc: 极深的虹膜，瞳孔外整圈细银环，如日全食；暗处微亮。
eclipse_full.prompt: very dark irises with a thin luminous pale-silver ring hugging each pupil, like a total eclipse, a cool low light that makes the eyes read clearly

eclipse_crescent.desc: 瞳缘上方一弯细银弦，只在近看或暗处可见。
eclipse_crescent.prompt: dark irises with a thin pale-silver crescent along the upper rim of each pupil

jade_lock.desc: 左鬓垂下一缕通透的玉色发，像打磨过的软玉由内透光。
jade_lock.prompt: a single lock of translucent jade-green hair falling from the left temple, softly lit from within like polished nephrite

jade_sheen.desc: 发间迎光处一层淡淡玉色光泽。
jade_sheen.prompt: a faint jade-green sheen in the hair where the light catches it

filament.desc: 发梢化作琉璃纤丝，末端泛冷白微光。
filament.prompt: hair ends that turn translucent like spun glass fibre, glowing a soft cool white at the very tips, hair loose enough to show the ends

glass_sheen.desc: 发梢一抹虹彩般的琉璃光泽。
glass_sheen.prompt: a faint iridescent glassy sheen along the hair ends

rime_lash.desc: 睫毛与眉梢天生霜白，与发色无关，像落了一层霜。
rime_lash.prompt: rime-white eyelashes and white outer brow tips regardless of hair colour, as if dusted with frost, eyes framed close

rime_tip.prompt: the outer tips of the eyebrows naturally frost-white

kiln_crackle.desc: 左鬓到颧骨一片细密开片，像青瓷冰裂釉，皮肤微有瓷光。
kiln_crackle.prompt: a fine network of crackle lines like crazed pale celadon glaze across the left temple and cheekbone, the skin there faintly glossy like fired porcelain, hair swept back from the left temple

ember_sigil.desc: 眼下一线烬纹（不完全显性，一份为淡）。描述由 CKGenomePortrait 的 mark 位点负责。

tide_ring.desc: 发丝上等距的盐白细环，像潮水在盐滩留下的圈痕。
tide_ring.prompt: hair with fine alternating salt-white bands at regular intervals, like tide rings left on a salt shore, long hair worn loose to show the bands

salt_band.desc: 发间一道淡淡的盐白横线。
salt_band.prompt: a single faint salt-white band running through the hair

gorge_split.desc: 双眉各被一道天生的窄隙劈开，像俯瞰的峡谷。
gorge_split.prompt: each eyebrow cleanly split by a narrow natural gap, like a canyon seen from above, hair kept clear of the brows

brow_notch.desc: 一侧眉尾天生一道小缺口。
brow_notch.prompt: a small natural notch in the outer third of one eyebrow

qi_xing.desc: 左颧到左鬓七颗小痣，排成北斗。
qi_xing.prompt: seven small dark moles arranged in the shape of the Big Dipper across the left cheekbone and temple, left cheek turned toward the light

san_tai.desc: 左眼下三颗斜列的小痣（东虹）。
san_tai.prompt: three small dark moles in a slanted line under the left eye

si_fu.desc: 左鬓四颗弧列的小痣（西虹）。
si_fu.prompt: four small dark moles in a small arc at the left temple

firefly.desc: 鼻梁与上颊薄荷绿的微光雀斑，雾里与暗处更亮，像萤火。
firefly.prompt: soft mint-green luminous freckles across the nose bridge and upper cheeks, glowing faintly like fireflies in fog, soft low light so the freckles read

firefly_trace.desc: 鼻梁上几点淡淡的薄荷微光。
firefly_trace.prompt: a few faint mint-green luminous freckles on the nose bridge

ash_wire.desc: 粗硬墨发，脑后平切，额前一道灰纹。
ash_wire.prompt: coarse ink-black hair cut blunt at the nape, with one ash-grey forelock stripe
ash_wire.prompt_young: short soft ink-black hair, the ash forelock only a faint thread
ash_wire.prompt_elder: thinned ink-black hair, the forelock stripe wider and frost-silver at the roots

ash_crop.desc: 墨发平切到下颌，没有额纹。
ash_crop.prompt: ink-black hair cut blunt at the jaw, with no forelock stripe
ash_crop.prompt_young: a soft jaw-length ink crop, still uneven in youth
ash_crop.prompt_elder: a jaw-length ink crop gone thin at the temples with age

ash_spoke.desc: 炭黑虹膜里，七点钟方向一根石墨色辐条。近看才稳。
ash_spoke.prompt: charcoal irises with a single graphite spoke at seven o'clock
ash_spoke.prompt_young: dark irises, the graphite spoke only a short tick in youth
ash_spoke.prompt_elder: charcoal irises, the graphite spoke longer and paler with age

ash_bone.desc: 眉骨低平、鼻梁宽、颊面平、下巴方。玉值式的骨相，过槛才完整。
ash_bone.prompt: a low straight brow shelf, a wide nasal bridge, flat cheek planes and a squared chin
ash_bone.prompt_young: a softer wide face, the brow shelf not yet heavy in youth
ash_bone.prompt_elder: the brow shelf heavier, cheek planes hollower, chin still square in age

ash_jaw.desc: 下颌厚，眉骨还没有王族那么低。
ash_jaw.prompt: a heavy jaw and a moderate brow shelf, cheeks still full
ash_jaw.prompt_young: a heavy jaw still padded with youth
ash_jaw.prompt_elder: a heavy jaw, the cheek softer and lined with age

ash_jawcast.desc: 暖泥肤。二十八岁后下颌浮出冷灰，此前看不出来。
ash_jawcast.prompt: warm clay skin with a cool grey cast along the jaw
ash_jawcast.prompt_young: even warm clay skin, the jaw still the same tone as the cheek
ash_jawcast.prompt_elder: warm clay skin, the cool grey jaw cast deeper, with a silver-violet thread at the hairline

ash_hook.desc: 重心在后脚，下颌平，右手拇指扣着领缘。约六成外显。
ash_hook.prompt: weight on the back foot, chin level, right thumb hooked on the collar edge, voice in short clipped orders
ash_hook.prompt_young: the back-foot stance loose, the thumb hook not yet a habit in youth
ash_hook.prompt_elder: the back-foot stance deeper, the thumb hook stiff, the voice lower and shorter with age

ash_cloak.desc: 左领敞开的短灰氅，霜银发丝压边。衣冠是家传的披法，不是冠。
ash_cloak.prompt: a short ash cloak, collar open on the left, frost-silver hairline trim on matte technical cloth
ash_cloak.prompt_young: the same short ash cloak worn a little large, trim still bright in youth
ash_cloak.prompt_elder: the short ash cloak worn thinner at the edge, trim dulled to brushed frost metal with age

ash_pure.desc: 颈纹延伸到锁骨，额纹分成平行两股。只在河图已显且两份纯血等位时出现。
ash_pure.prompt: the neck tracery continues onto the collarbone and the ash forelock stripe splits into two parallel threads
ash_pure.prompt_young: the split forelock threads are short, the collarbone tracery faint in a young pure line
ash_pure.prompt_elder: the split forelock threads are frost-silver and the collarbone tracery deeper with age

marshal_strap.desc: 左肩一道皮带压出来的浅痕，皮略厚。旗帅自家的征，不是河图。
marshal_strap.prompt: a pale pressure line on the left shoulder where a strap sits, the skin there slightly thickened
marshal_strap.prompt_young: a faint shoulder pressure line, not yet thickened in youth
marshal_strap.prompt_elder: a pale shoulder pressure line, the skin thicker and a little creased with age

folk_ash_hair.desc: 风剪过的灰棕发，后颈参差。
folk_ash_hair.prompt: ash-brown hair cropped by weather, uneven at the nape
folk_ash_hair.prompt_young: softer ash-brown hair, the nape still uneven in youth
folk_ash_hair.prompt_elder: ash-brown hair thinner and more uneven at the nape with age

folk_ash_skin.prompt: warm clay skin with no grey cast along the jaw
folk_ash_skin.prompt_young: even warm clay skin, smoother in youth
folk_ash_skin.prompt_elder: warm clay skin, more creased at the eyes with age, still no grey jaw cast

folk_ash_bone.desc: 劳作出来的宽下颌，眉骨低，颊有日晒纹。
folk_ash_bone.prompt: a broad work-worn jaw and a low brow, cheeks creased by weather
folk_ash_bone.prompt_young: a broad jaw still soft, the brow not yet low in youth
folk_ash_bone.prompt_elder: a broader jaw, the brow lower and the cheeks more lined with age

sy_geom.desc: 蓝黑直发中分，齐到下颌，切线几何。两份才显。
sy_geom.prompt: straight blue-black hair, centre-parted, cut on a geometric line at the jaw
sy_geom.prompt_young: shorter blue-black hair, the jaw line not yet exact in youth
sy_geom.prompt_elder: blue-black hair still geometric, with a dull silver thread at the part in age

sy_crop.desc: 墨发短于下颌，不是几何齐切。
sy_crop.prompt: straight black hair cut shorter than the jaw, not a geometric line
sy_crop.prompt_young: a soft black crop above the jaw in youth
sy_crop.prompt_elder: a black crop, slightly receded at the temples with age

sy_sclera.desc: 巩膜是暮灰而不是白，不充血。近看，和银环不是同一征。
sy_sclera.prompt: dusk-grey sclera rather than white, never bloodshot, a quiet field around the iris
sy_sclera.prompt_young: sclera only a shade off white in youth
sy_sclera.prompt_elder: sclera a deeper dusk-grey, still clear, in age

sy_bridge.desc: 窄脸、高鼻梁、颊浅、人中长。
sy_bridge.prompt: a narrow face, a high nasal bridge, shallow cheeks and a long philtrum
sy_bridge.prompt_young: a narrow face still soft, the bridge not yet high in youth
sy_bridge.prompt_elder: a narrower face, cheeks hollower, the bridge sharper with age

sy_cheek.desc: 颊浅，鼻梁还没有王室那么高。
sy_cheek.prompt: shallow cheeks and a straight nose, the bridge not yet high
sy_cheek.prompt_young: shallow cheeks still rounded in youth
sy_cheek.prompt_elder: shallower cheeks and a finer nose with age

sy_olive.desc: 冷橄榄带石板灰，不是苍白。
sy_olive.prompt: cool olive-slate skin, matte, not pale
sy_olive.prompt_young: cool olive-slate skin, a little warmer and smoother in youth
sy_olive.prompt_elder: cooler olive-slate skin, drier at the cheek, in age

sy_still.desc: 二十二岁后视线放稳，少眨眼，嘴角不单侧上扬。
sy_still.prompt: a still gaze, a low blink, no one-sided smile, voice measured and quiet
sy_still.prompt_young: an ordinary blink and a mouth that still moves freely in youth
sy_still.prompt_elder: a stiller gaze, an even lower blink, the voice thinner with age

sy_collar.desc: 窄霜银领，衣身墨色，一条竖向霜线。父传全女。
sy_collar.prompt: a narrow frost-silver collar band on an ink coat, one vertical frost stitch, matte cloth
sy_collar.prompt_young: the narrow collar band worn slightly loose in youth
sy_collar.prompt_elder: the narrow collar band still exact, the frost stitch dulled with age

sy_pure.desc: 瞳外银环变成同心两圈。须全朔已显且两份纯血。
sy_pure.prompt: two thin concentric pale-silver rings around each pupil, the outer ring finer than the inner
sy_pure.prompt_young: the outer silver ring only a broken arc in a young pure line
sy_pure.prompt_elder: both silver rings complete and a little brighter against dusk-grey sclera in age

sy_canthus.desc: 外眼角一点霜银，不是环。
sy_canthus.prompt: one pale-silver tick at the outer corner of each eye, not a ring
sy_canthus.prompt_young: a tiny pale tick at the outer eye corner, easy to miss in youth
sy_canthus.prompt_elder: a slightly longer pale tick at the outer eye corner in age

folk_sy_hair.desc: 直黑发，发际有深靛兜影。
folk_sy_hair.prompt: straight black hair with a deep indigo hood-line across the brow
folk_sy_hair.prompt_young: straight black hair, the indigo hood-line faint in youth
folk_sy_hair.prompt_elder: straight black hair, the indigo hood-line wider with age

folk_sy_skin.desc: 风燎过的石板肤，鼻梁更暗。
folk_sy_skin.prompt: wind-burned slate skin, darker across the nose
folk_sy_skin.prompt_young: slate skin, the nose not yet darker in youth
folk_sy_skin.prompt_elder: slate skin, the nose darker and the cheek drier with age

folk_sy_bone.desc: 鼻梁短、下颌紧，不像宫里的窄高脸。
folk_sy_bone.prompt: a short nasal bridge and a compact jaw, unlike the narrow court face
folk_sy_bone.prompt_young: a short bridge and a compact jaw still soft in youth
folk_sy_bone.prompt_elder: a shorter-looking bridge and a more compact jaw with age

qh_smooth.desc: 其余的发光滑如水梳过，右耳后一挽。圆耳。
qh_smooth.prompt: the rest of the hair smooth and water-combed, one tuck behind the right ear
qh_smooth.prompt_young: softer ink hair, the tuck loose and unfinished in youth
qh_smooth.prompt_elder: water-combed ink hair, finer, the tuck still exact in age

qh_tuck.desc: 右耳后一挽，发没有王族那么顺。
qh_tuck.prompt: ink hair with one tuck behind the right ear, the lengths less smooth
qh_tuck.prompt_young: a loose tuck behind the right ear in youth
qh_tuck.prompt_elder: a precise tuck, the hair finer with age

qh_limbal.desc: 松绿灰虹膜，边缘一圈软玉色环。两份才显。
qh_limbal.prompt: pine-grey irises with a soft nephrite ring at the limbus
qh_limbal.prompt_young: pine-grey irises, the nephrite limbal ring only a faint arc in youth
qh_limbal.prompt_elder: pine-grey irises, the nephrite limbal ring wider and softer with age

qh_oval.desc: 窄卵面、颊峰低、鼻梁细直、下颌柔。
qh_oval.prompt: a narrow oval face, a low cheek apex, a fine straight nose and a gentle jaw
qh_oval.prompt_young: a narrow oval still rounder, the nose finer but short in youth
qh_oval.prompt_elder: a narrower oval, the cheek lower and the nose still fine in age

qh_lowcheek.desc: 颊峰低，卵面还没那么窄。
qh_lowcheek.prompt: a low cheek apex and a straight nose on a moderate oval
qh_lowcheek.prompt_young: a low cheek still full in youth
qh_lowcheek.prompt_elder: a lower cheek apex and a finer nose with age

qh_undertone.desc: 凉白里带青灰，只随母亲的数值走。
qh_undertone.prompt: cool fair skin with a green-grey undertone, matte rather than luminous
qh_undertone.prompt_young: cool fair skin, the green-grey undertone faint in youth
qh_undertone.prompt_elder: cooler fair skin, the green-grey undertone clearer at the temple in age

qh_fold.desc: 双手交叠，声线平，听人时头微侧。约六成外显。
qh_fold.prompt: hands folded, voice even, a slight head tilt when listening
qh_fold.prompt_young: hands not yet folded by habit, the head tilt occasional in youth
qh_fold.prompt_elder: hands folded closer, the head tilt smaller, the voice drier with age

qh_collar.desc: 哑光石板高闭领，一条软玉色压线，短披肩。
qh_collar.prompt: a high closed collar of matte slate, one nephrite-thread placket, a short capelet
qh_collar.prompt_young: the closed slate collar a little tall for the neck in youth
qh_collar.prompt_elder: the closed slate collar still exact, the nephrite thread paler with age

qh_pure.desc: 玉缕透到发根，颈后再有一缕极细的同色发。须玉缕已显。
qh_pure.prompt: the jade lock is translucent to the root and a second micro-lock of the same green sits at the nape
qh_pure.prompt_young: the nape micro-lock is short and the root translucency slight in youth
qh_pure.prompt_elder: the nape micro-lock longer, the root translucency clearer in age

qh_web.desc: 右拇指蹼一块厚茧。渡口世家的手，不是玉缕。
qh_web.prompt: a thickened pad of skin in the right thumb web
qh_web.prompt_young: a slight thickening in the right thumb web in youth
qh_web.prompt_elder: a thicker pad in the right thumb web, more creased with age

folk_qh_hair.desc: 墨发松着，发梢常湿，没有鬓缕。
folk_qh_hair.prompt: loose ink-black hair, often damp at the ends, no temple lock
folk_qh_hair.prompt_young: looser ink-black hair, ends damp, shorter in youth
folk_qh_hair.prompt_elder: loose ink-black hair, ends still damp, finer with age

folk_qh_skin.desc: 河岸暖棕，只有颊窝一点雾灰。
folk_qh_skin.prompt: river-tan skin with cool mist-grey only in the hollow of the cheek
folk_qh_skin.prompt_young: river-tan skin, the cheek hollow not yet grey in youth
folk_qh_skin.prompt_elder: river-tan skin, the cheek hollow greyer with age

folk_qh_bone.desc: 下巴圆，鼻梁有一点骨节。
folk_qh_bone.prompt: a soft rounded chin and a nose with a slight bridge bump
folk_qh_bone.prompt_young: a rounder chin, the bridge bump small in youth
folk_qh_bone.prompt_elder: a rounded chin and a more noticeable bridge bump with age

lt_asym.desc: 玻璃般的直墨发，左侧更长。两份才显，和灯丝不是一回事。
lt_asym.prompt: glassy-straight dark hair in an asymmetric cut, longer on the left
lt_asym.prompt_young: dark hair only slightly longer on the left, still soft in youth
lt_asym.prompt_elder: the left side still longer, the lengths finer and a little grey at the scalp in age

lt_merchantcut.prompt: dark hair cut even, practical, no long left side
lt_merchantcut.prompt_young: an even dark crop, a little fluffy in youth
lt_merchantcut.prompt_elder: an even dark crop, thinner at the temples with age

lt_quartz.desc: 烟晶色虹膜，一点冷白高光，不是金瞳。
lt_quartz.prompt: smoky-quartz irises with a pinpoint cool-white catchlight
lt_quartz.prompt_young: smoky-quartz irises, the catchlight soft and wide in youth
lt_quartz.prompt_elder: smoky-quartz irises, the catchlight smaller and sharper with age

lt_soft.desc: 软卵面、短鼻、圆颏、眉会动。近看才和普通卵面分开。
lt_soft.prompt: a soft oval face, a short nose, a rounded chin and mobile brows
lt_soft.prompt_young: a softer rounder face, the nose short, brows very mobile in youth
lt_soft.prompt_elder: a soft oval, the chin a little sharper, brows still mobile in age

lt_shortchin.prompt: a short chin and ordinary cheeks
lt_shortchin.prompt_young: a short chin still round in youth
lt_shortchin.prompt_elder: a shorter-looking chin with a finer jawline in age

lt_sheen.desc: 颊骨一层冷玻璃泽。伯爵或立过誓才显。
lt_sheen.prompt: an even neutral beige skin with a faint cool sheen on the cheekbones, like frosted glass
lt_sheen.prompt_young: even neutral beige skin, the cheek sheen not yet present
lt_sheen.prompt_elder: neutral beige skin, the cool cheek sheen wider and drier with age

lt_count.desc: 下颌微抬，手指像在数看不见的钱。约六成外显。
lt_count.prompt: chin slightly lifted, fingers counting invisible coins, voice in a quick even cadence
lt_count.prompt_young: the chin lift occasional, the finger count not yet a habit in youth
lt_count.prompt_elder: the chin lift habitual, the finger count slower, the voice drier with age

lt_bind.desc: 短石板外套，领与下摆是玻璃纤维压边。

lt_bind.prompt_young: the glass-fibre binding bright and a little stiff in youth
lt_bind.prompt_elder: the glass-fibre binding still clear, the jacket softer at the edge with age

lt_pure.desc: 灯丝之内再有一圈更短的玻璃丝。须灯丝已显且两份纯血。
lt_pure.prompt: a second, shorter ring of glass fibre just inside the glowing hair ends
lt_pure.prompt_young: the inner glass ring only a few fibres long in youth
lt_pure.prompt_elder: the inner glass ring longer and still cool-white in age

lt_knuckle.desc: 指节一层冷霜泽，像常握玻璃。
lt_knuckle.prompt: a cool frosted sheen across the knuckles, as if they handled cold glass
lt_knuckle.prompt_young: a faint cool sheen on the knuckles in youth
lt_knuckle.prompt_elder: a wider cool sheen on the knuckles, skin drier with age

folk_lt_hair.desc: 深发束起干活，发梢普通、不透。
folk_lt_hair.prompt: practical dark hair tied up, the ends ordinary and opaque
folk_lt_hair.prompt_young: dark hair tied up, a little messy in youth
folk_lt_hair.prompt_elder: dark hair tied up, finer at the scalp with age, ends still opaque

folk_lt_skin.desc: 中性米色，额心因港风更亮。
folk_lt_skin.prompt: neutral beige skin, slightly shinier at the forehead from harbor weather
folk_lt_skin.prompt_young: neutral beige skin, the forehead shine light in youth
folk_lt_skin.prompt_elder: neutral beige skin, the forehead drier and shinier with age

folk_lt_bone.prompt: a wide easy mouth and average cheekbones
folk_lt_bone.prompt_young: a wide mouth, cheeks still round in youth
folk_lt_bone.prompt_elder: a wide mouth and slightly lower cheeks with age

fc_temple.desc: 发身是墨，只有两鬓霜银，细而直。
fc_temple.prompt: ink hair, fine and straight, frost-silver only at the temples
fc_temple.prompt_young: ink hair, the temple silver only a few hairs in youth
fc_temple.prompt_elder: ink hair finer, the temple silver wider toward the part in age

fc_short.desc: 鬓角一点霜，发身不一定是墨。
fc_short.prompt: a small frost-silver patch at one temple, the rest of the hair dark
fc_short.prompt_young: a few frost-silver hairs at one temple in youth
fc_short.prompt_elder: a wider frost-silver patch at one temple in age

fc_storm.desc: 风暴灰虹膜，瞳孔边缘一圈更深的石板色。两份才显。
fc_storm.prompt: storm-grey irises with a darker slate collar around the pupil
fc_storm.prompt_young: storm-grey irises, the slate collar faint in youth
fc_storm.prompt_elder: storm-grey irises, the slate collar wider with age

fc_long.desc: 长窄脸、薄鼻、眉骨高、颊微凹。
fc_long.prompt: a long narrow face, a thin nose, a high brow bone and a slight hollow cheek
fc_long.prompt_young: a long face still softer, the nose thin, the cheek not hollow in youth
fc_long.prompt_elder: a longer-looking face, the cheek hollower, the nose still thin in age

fc_thin.prompt: a thin nose and a moderately long face
fc_thin.prompt_young: a thin nose on a face that is still short in youth
fc_thin.prompt_elder: a thinner-looking nose and a longer face with age

fc_skin.desc: 冷粉灰，太阳穴细血管看起来是银而不是蓝。父传全女。
fc_skin.prompt: cool pink-grey skin, the fine temple vessels reading silver rather than blue
fc_skin.prompt_young: cool pink-grey skin, temple vessels hardly visible in youth
fc_skin.prompt_elder: cooler pink-grey skin, temple vessels a little clearer and still silver in age

fc_hands.desc: 二十八岁后手才放稳，声线往下走。
fc_hands.prompt: upright posture, hands quiet at the sides, voice low and unhurried
fc_hands.prompt_young: upright posture, hands still restless in youth
fc_hands.prompt_elder: upright posture a little shorter, hands quieter, voice lower with age

fc_collar.desc: 高哑光领，霜白发丝滚边，短氅左右对称。
fc_collar.prompt: a tall matte collar, frost-white hairline piping, a short symmetrical cloak
fc_collar.prompt_young: the tall collar slightly too high, piping very bright in youth
fc_collar.prompt_elder: the tall collar still symmetrical, piping softened to brushed frost metal in age

fc_pure.desc: 两鬓霜银在头顶汇成一条细线。须霜睫已显且两份纯血。
fc_pure.prompt: the temple silver of the hair meets in a fine line over the top of the head
fc_pure.prompt_young: the meeting line of temple silver is broken in youth
fc_pure.prompt_elder: the meeting line of temple silver is continuous and wider in age

fc_mouth.desc: 默认闭唇，嘴角平，没有笑纹。
fc_mouth.prompt: lips closed by default, corners level, no smile crease
fc_mouth.prompt_young: lips often closed, the face still smooth in youth
fc_mouth.prompt_elder: lips closed, a level line, still no smile crease in age

folk_fc_hair.desc: 深发，梢是钝灰，不是鬓银。
folk_fc_hair.prompt: dark hair faded at the tips to a dull grey, not silver at the temples
folk_fc_hair.prompt_young: dark hair, the dull grey tips short in youth
folk_fc_hair.prompt_elder: dark hair, the dull grey tips longer with age, temples still dark

folk_fc_skin.desc: 高原肤，只有鼻翼发红粗糙。
folk_fc_skin.prompt: high-plateau skin, chapped and pink only at the nostrils
folk_fc_skin.prompt_young: high-plateau skin, nostrils barely chapped in youth
folk_fc_skin.prompt_elder: high-plateau skin, nostrils more chapped, cheeks drier with age

folk_fc_bone.prompt: a broad pastoral face with a short nose
folk_fc_bone.prompt_young: a broad face, the nose short and the cheeks full in youth
folk_fc_bone.prompt_elder: a broad face, the nose still short, cheeks lower with age

eo_sweep.desc: 密黑微卷，向后掠，左鬓一条青灰纹，不是开片。
eo_sweep.prompt: dense black hair with a slight wave, swept back, a celadon-grey streak at the left temple
eo_sweep.prompt_young: dense black hair, the celadon-grey streak only a few hairs in youth
eo_sweep.prompt_elder: dense black hair swept back, the celadon-grey streak wider in age

eo_short.prompt: black hair swept back, no grey-green streak
eo_short.prompt_young: shorter black hair swept back in youth
eo_short.prompt_elder: black hair swept back, thinner at the temples with age

eo_stroma.desc: 深暮色虹膜，基质里几根细裂丝。两份才显。
eo_stroma.prompt: deep dusk irises with a few fine crackle lines in the stroma
eo_stroma.prompt_young: deep dusk irises, one short crackle line in youth
eo_stroma.prompt_elder: deep dusk irises, the stromal crackle lines a little longer with age

eo_zygo.desc: 颧骨宽、鼻短而头平、眉脊重。

eo_zygo.prompt_young: broad cheekbones still padded, the nose short in youth
eo_zygo.prompt_elder: broader-looking cheekbones, the brow ridge heavier in age

eo_shortnose.desc: 鼻短头平，颧还没有那么宽。
eo_shortnose.prompt: a short nose with a flat tip and moderate cheeks
eo_shortnose.prompt_young: a short flat nose, cheeks still round in youth
eo_shortnose.prompt_elder: a short flat nose and slightly wider cheeks with age

eo_clay.desc: 暖棕里带灰绿，像窑土，不是橙色。
eo_clay.prompt: warm tan skin with a grey-green undertone, like kiln clay, matte
eo_clay.prompt_young: warm tan skin, the grey-green undertone faint in youth
eo_clay.prompt_elder: warm tan skin, the grey-green undertone clearer in the creases with age

eo_pause.desc: 肩平，先停一下再说话，掌心向下。约六成外显。
eo_pause.prompt: shoulders square, a pause before speech, a palm-down gesture, voice low
eo_pause.prompt_young: shoulders square, the pause not yet habitual in youth
eo_pause.prompt_elder: shoulders still square, the pause longer, the voice rougher with age

eo_collar.desc: 领口左偏，让出左鬓，压边是青灰。只传儿子。

eo_collar.prompt_young: the left collar cut a little uneven in youth
eo_collar.prompt_elder: the left collar cut still open, the celadon piping dulled with age

eo_pure.desc: 开片延伸到下颌，青灰发纹分叉。须冰裂已显且两份纯血。
eo_pure.prompt: the celadon crackle reaches the jawline and the temple streak forks
eo_pure.prompt_young: the forked streak is short and the jawline crackle faint in youth
eo_pure.prompt_elder: the forked streak wider and the jawline crackle clearer in age

eo_notch.desc: 左耳垂一个小缺口，耳廓仍圆、贴近。
eo_notch.prompt: a small notch in the left earlobe; the ear is round and close-set
eo_notch.prompt_young: a shallow notch in the left earlobe in youth
eo_notch.prompt_elder: a small notch in the left earlobe, the lobe a little longer with age

folk_eo_hair.desc: 黑发剪短，沾一点灰，方便进窑。

folk_eo_hair.prompt_young: short black hair, the dusting light in youth
folk_eo_hair.prompt_elder: short black hair, thinner, still dust-dulled with age

folk_eo_skin.desc: 窑镇暖棕，只有手纹是灰的。
folk_eo_skin.prompt: kiln-town tan, grey only in the creases of the hands
folk_eo_skin.prompt_young: kiln-town tan, hand creases barely grey in youth
folk_eo_skin.prompt_elder: kiln-town tan, hand creases greyer and deeper with age

folk_eo_bone.desc: 劳作的方颌，颧骨并不宽。
folk_eo_bone.prompt: a square work jaw without the wide cheekbones of the kiln house
folk_eo_bone.prompt_young: a square jaw still soft in youth
folk_eo_bone.prompt_elder: a squarer jaw, cheeks ordinary, with age

sm_coil.desc: 发厚，在颈后盘低，手感盐硬。两份才显。

sm_coil.prompt_young: thick hair, the nape coil loose and less stiff in youth
sm_coil.prompt_elder: thick hair, the nape coil lower, salt-stiff and a little grey in age

sm_knot.prompt_young: a loose low knot in youth
sm_knot.prompt_elder: a low knot, finer hair, in age

sm_iris.desc: 海玻璃般的灰绿虹膜，角膜缘一圈淡盐色。父传全女。

sm_iris.prompt_young: sea-glass irises, the salt limbal ring faint in youth
sm_iris.prompt_elder: sea-glass irises, the salt limbal ring a little wider with age

sm_wide.desc: 脸宽、鼻短而阔、颊满、下颌浅。

sm_wide.prompt_elder: a wide face, cheeks a little lower, the nose still short and broad in age

sm_full.prompt_elder: full cheeks, a little lower with age

sm_sheen.desc: 日晒橄榄肤，表面一层凉盐光。只随母亲。

sm_sheen.prompt_young: olive skin, the salt sheen faint in youth
sm_sheen.prompt_elder: olive skin, the salt sheen drier and more even in age

sm_stance.desc: 二十四岁后站距变宽，转身先转头。
sm_stance.prompt: a wide stance, the head turning before the body, voice counting like a tide
sm_stance.prompt_young: a narrower stance, the head and body turning together in youth
sm_stance.prompt_elder: a wider stance, the head turn slower, the voice lower with age

sm_band.desc: 短外套，胸前两道霜薄荷横带，领口开。
sm_band.prompt: a cropped jacket with two horizontal frost-mint bands and an open throat, matte cloth
sm_band.prompt_young: the cropped jacket a little long, the mint bands very clean in youth
sm_band.prompt_elder: the cropped jacket still open at the throat, the mint bands softened with age

sm_pure.desc: 潮环至少三道且间距相等，盐色角膜缘闭合成环。须潮痕已显。

sm_pure.prompt_young: three hair rings present but the limbus ring still open in youth
sm_pure.prompt_elder: three or more hair rings, the limbus ring complete and a little wider in age

sm_lip.prompt_young: a faint horizontal crease on the lower lip in youth
sm_lip.prompt_elder: a deeper horizontal crease on the lower lip with age

folk_sm_hair.desc: 盐硬的深发松辫，没有等距白环。

folk_sm_hair.prompt_young: a loose work braid, less stiff in youth
folk_sm_hair.prompt_elder: a work braid, stiffer and a little grey, still without even bands, in age

folk_sm_skin.desc: 芦滩暖棕，只有发际有干盐。

folk_sm_skin.prompt_young: reed-marsh tan, the hairline salt faint in youth
folk_sm_skin.prompt_elder: reed-marsh tan, the hairline salt drier and wider with age

folk_sm_bone.prompt: a sun-squint face with a broad nose and shallow cheeks
folk_sm_bone.prompt_young: a sun-squint face, cheeks still fuller in youth
folk_sm_bone.prompt_elder: a sun-squint face, the nose broad, cheeks shallower with age

ig_part.prompt_young: shorter iron-black hair, the side part soft in youth
ig_part.prompt_elder: iron-black hair, the side part higher, scalp a little visible in age

ig_crop.prompt: a short iron-black crop with no side part
ig_crop.prompt_young: a soft short iron-black crop in youth
ig_crop.prompt_elder: a short iron-black crop, thinner on top with age

ig_catch.desc: 铁灰虹膜，高光是一条扁的长方形。两份才显。

ig_catch.prompt_young: iron-grey irises, the catchlight shorter in youth
ig_catch.prompt_elder: iron-grey irises, the rectangular catchlight longer with age

ig_jaw.desc: 下颌重、鼻长梁高、下颌角宽。近看才稳。

ig_jaw.prompt_young: a heavy jaw still padded, the nose long but softer in youth
ig_jaw.prompt_elder: a heavier jaw angle, the nose still long, cheeks lower in age

ig_gonial.desc: 下颌角宽，鼻还没有那么长。
ig_gonial.prompt: a wide jaw angle and a straight medium nose
ig_gonial.prompt_young: a wide jaw angle, still soft in youth
ig_gonial.prompt_elder: a wider jaw angle and a leaner cheek in age

ig_steel.desc: 中性红棕，底色是冷钢，毛孔可见。
ig_steel.prompt: ruddy-neutral skin with a cool steel undertone and visible pores
ig_steel.prompt_young: ruddy-neutral skin, pores finer, the steel undertone light in youth
ig_steel.prompt_elder: ruddy-neutral skin, pores clearer, the steel undertone cooler in age

ig_lean.desc: 身体前倾，收下颌，休息时拳是握着的。约六成外显。
ig_lean.prompt: a forward lean, chin tucked, the resting hand closed, voice one hard syllable
ig_lean.prompt_young: a slight forward lean, the hand not yet closed at rest in youth
ig_lean.prompt_elder: a deeper forward lean, the closed hand stiffer, the voice rougher with age

ig_throat.desc: 二十五岁后，拉丝钢喉领才坐正。
ig_throat.prompt: a brushed-steel throat plate sitting square, with a short matte cape
ig_throat.prompt_young: a brushed-steel throat plate sitting slightly crooked
ig_throat.prompt_elder: a brushed-steel throat plate sitting square, the edge dulled with age

ig_pure.desc: 双眉的窄隙之外，发际正中再有一个同样的缺口。须峡眉已显。
ig_pure.prompt: a matching narrow notch in the centre hairline, aligned with the brow gaps
ig_pure.prompt_young: the hairline notch shallow in youth
ig_pure.prompt_elder: the hairline notch a little deeper, still narrow, in age

ig_ridge.desc: 两手第一指节一道凸棱。
ig_ridge.prompt: a raised ridge across the first knuckles of both hands
ig_ridge.prompt_young: a slight ridge across the first knuckles in youth
ig_ridge.prompt_elder: a higher ridge across the first knuckles with age

folk_ig_hair.desc: 深发用刀削短，没有侧分。
folk_ig_hair.prompt: short dark hair cut with a knife, no side part
folk_ig_hair.prompt_young: short knife-cut dark hair, uneven in youth
folk_ig_hair.prompt_elder: short knife-cut dark hair, thinner, still without a side part, in age

folk_ig_skin.desc: 峡尘肤，毛孔发灰，只有指节发红。

folk_ig_skin.prompt_young: canyon-dust skin, knuckles barely ruddy in youth
folk_ig_skin.prompt_elder: canyon-dust skin, pores greyer, knuckles ruddier with age

folk_ig_bone.desc: 鼻头钝、下颌因干活而重。
folk_ig_bone.prompt: a blunt nose and a jaw heavy from work
folk_ig_bone.prompt_young: a blunt nose and a jaw still soft in youth
folk_ig_bone.prompt_elder: a blunter nose and a heavier work jaw with age

sr_shave.desc: 墨发直，耳上一条窄剃线。
sr_shave.prompt: straight ink hair with a narrow shaved line above the ear
sr_shave.prompt_young: ink hair, the shaved line shorter and softer in youth
sr_shave.prompt_elder: ink hair, the shaved line a little higher and wider with age

sr_half.prompt: straight dark hair with a half-length shaved line above one ear
sr_half.prompt_young: a short half-line above one ear in youth
sr_half.prompt_elder: a half-length shaved line, a little wider with age

sr_fleck.desc: 近黑虹膜里三粒淡斑，排成小弧。两份才显。不是脸上的痣。
sr_fleck.prompt: near-black irises with exactly three tiny pale flecks in a small arc
sr_fleck.prompt_young: near-black irises, only one pale fleck clear in youth
sr_fleck.prompt_elder: near-black irises, the three pale flecks a little larger with age

sr_mid.desc: 中面长、颊不高、鼻直、眉平。
sr_mid.prompt: a long midface, modest cheeks, a straight nose and level brows
sr_mid.prompt_young: a long midface still softer, brows level in youth
sr_mid.prompt_elder: a longer midface, cheeks lower, brows still level in age

sr_brow.desc: 眉骨平，中面还没那么长。
sr_brow.prompt: level brows and a moderate midface
sr_brow.prompt_young: level brows on a shorter face in youth
sr_brow.prompt_elder: level brows and a slightly longer midface with age

sr_olive.prompt: even light-olive skin, matte, no patches
sr_olive.prompt_young: even light-olive skin, a little warmer in youth
sr_olive.prompt_elder: even light-olive skin, drier at the cheek with age

sr_glance.desc: 想事情时视线往左上，食指点两下。父传全女。
sr_glance.prompt: the gaze ticks up and to the left when thinking, then the index finger taps twice
sr_glance.prompt_young: the up-left glance occasional, the tap not yet paired in youth
sr_glance.prompt_elder: the up-left glance slower, the double tap still exact in age

sr_arc.desc: 不对称短氅，一道浅弧霜线，墨色领。
sr_arc.prompt: an asymmetric short cloak with a shallow frost stitch in an arc, and an ink collar
sr_arc.prompt_young: the short cloak a little long, the arc stitch very bright in youth
sr_arc.prompt_elder: the short cloak still asymmetric, the arc stitch softened with age

sr_pure.desc: 三粒虹膜淡斑与外三颗痣的弧对齐。须七星已显且两份纯血。
sr_pure.prompt: the three pale iris flecks align with the arc of the outer three moles
sr_pure.prompt_young: the flecks and the outer moles nearly align, still a little off in youth
sr_pure.prompt_elder: the flecks and the outer moles align exactly in age

sr_tap.desc: 食指像刚点过两下，然后停住。东虹自家的手势。
sr_tap.prompt: the index finger rests as if it has just tapped twice, then gone still
sr_tap.prompt_young: an occasional single tap, not yet a double, in youth
sr_tap.prompt_elder: the double-tap rest still exact, the finger a little stiffer in age

sr_shoulder.desc: 左肩比右肩略高。西虹自家的站法。
sr_shoulder.prompt: the left shoulder sits slightly higher than the right
sr_shoulder.prompt_young: the left shoulder only a little high, easy to miss in youth
sr_shoulder.prompt_elder: the left shoulder higher, the line of the neck a little shorter in age

folk_sr_hair.desc: 渡口黑发，被风缠着，没有剃线。
folk_sr_hair.prompt: ferry-black hair, wind-tangled, with no shaved line
folk_sr_hair.prompt_young: wind-tangled black hair, shorter in youth
folk_sr_hair.prompt_elder: wind-tangled black hair, a little grey, still with no shaved line, in age

folk_sr_skin.desc: 桥镇均匀肤，只有领口更暗一点。
folk_sr_skin.prompt: even bridge-town skin, a little darker at the collar line
folk_sr_skin.prompt_young: even bridge-town skin, the collar line not yet darker in youth
folk_sr_skin.prompt_elder: even bridge-town skin, the collar line darker with age

folk_sr_bone.prompt: an ordinary oval face with level brows and a medium nose
folk_sr_bone.prompt_young: an ordinary oval, cheeks fuller in youth
folk_sr_bone.prompt_elder: an ordinary oval, cheeks slightly lower with age

sz_wave.desc: 柔软的深色波浪，梢是雾灰，不是金。
sz_wave.prompt: soft dark waves with fog-grey tips, tucked behind one ear
sz_wave.prompt_young: softer shorter waves, the fog-grey tips only a haze in youth
sz_wave.prompt_elder: dark waves, the fog-grey tips longer and duller with age

sz_short.prompt: short dark waves with ordinary dark tips
sz_short.prompt_elder: shorter dark waves, a little finer with age

sz_moss.desc: 苔绿虹膜，角膜缘一圈薄荷雾。亮度跟母亲的数值。
sz_moss.prompt: moss irises with a pale mint haze at the limbus
sz_moss.prompt_young: moss irises, the mint limbal haze faint in youth
sz_moss.prompt_elder: moss irises, the mint limbal haze a little wider with age

sz_round.prompt: a round face, a small nose, low cheeks and wide-set eyes
sz_round.prompt_young: a rounder face, the nose small, cheeks full in youth
sz_round.prompt_elder: a round face, cheeks lower, the nose still small in age

sz_smallnose.prompt: a small nose and moderate cheeks
sz_smallnose.prompt_young: a small nose, cheeks fuller in youth
sz_smallnose.prompt_elder: a small nose and slightly lower cheeks with age

sz_mint.desc: 暖米色，阴影里一点薄荷底。
sz_mint.prompt: warm beige skin with a cool mint undertone in the shadows
sz_mint.prompt_young: warm beige skin, the mint undertone faint in youth
sz_mint.prompt_elder: warm beige skin, the mint undertone clearer in the shadows with age

sz_listen.desc: 二十六岁后才习惯侧过来听，笑来得晚。
sz_listen.prompt: a lean-in to listen, the smile arriving late, voice soft and short
sz_listen.prompt_young: a quicker smile, the lean-in not yet habitual in youth
sz_listen.prompt_elder: a slower lean-in, the late smile smaller, the voice softer with age

sz_hood.desc: 哑光石板兜领，一道薄荷缝，短披。
sz_hood.prompt: a hood-collar of matte slate with one mint stitch and a short cape
sz_hood.prompt_young: the hood-collar a little deep, the mint stitch bright in youth
sz_hood.prompt_elder: the hood-collar still soft, the mint stitch paler with age

sz_pure.desc: 萤斑在鼻梁上收成一条窄桥，薄荷角膜缘闭合成环。须萤斑已显。
sz_pure.prompt: the luminous freckles tighten into a narrow bridge across the nose and the mint limbal haze closes into a ring
sz_pure.prompt_young: the freckle bridge is short and the limbal ring still open in youth
sz_pure.prompt_elder: the freckle bridge complete and the limbal ring closed in age

sz_squint.desc: 左眼静息时比右眼略窄。
sz_squint.prompt: the left eye rests a little narrower than the right
sz_squint.prompt_young: the left eye only slightly narrower, easy to miss in youth
sz_squint.prompt_elder: the left eye narrower at rest, the difference clearer with age

folk_sz_hair.desc: 紧的深卷，带着雾气，梢不发灰。
folk_sz_hair.prompt: tight dark curls with fog moisture, tips not grey
folk_sz_hair.prompt_young: tight dark curls, softer in youth, tips dark
folk_sz_hair.prompt_elder: tight dark curls, a little looser with age, tips still dark

folk_sz_skin.desc: 林间米色，雀斑普通、不发光。
folk_sz_skin.prompt: forest beige skin, freckles ordinary and not luminous
folk_sz_skin.prompt_young: forest beige skin, ordinary freckles light in youth
folk_sz_skin.prompt_elder: forest beige skin, ordinary freckles a little denser with age, still not luminous

folk_sz_bone.desc: 圆脸、小鼻、眼距宽，没有光斑。
folk_sz_bone.prompt: a round fog-wood face with a small nose and wide-set eyes
folk_sz_bone.prompt_young: a rounder face, small nose, in youth
folk_sz_bone.prompt_elder: a round face, cheeks lower, nose still small, in age

ashbanner.name: 灰烬邦
ashbanner.motto: 每一代都要重新打出来

succession.name: 擎旗公推
succession.desc: 陆桥议会在已觉醒的河图者中公推：勋位、荣衔、等级依次比较。未觉醒的携因者没有席位。

crisis.contested_desc: 两位以上觉醒者分数相近，城堡群各拥其主。
crisis.foreign_desc: 觉醒者另有三成以上外邦王血，邻国借题干预。

edge.name: 灰边
edge.desc: 灰烬邦不问出身：有王血而无河图，只是普通人，没有污名。

verify.name: 燃香验图
verify.desc: 祠堂以烬香熏颈：真河图在香烟下泛出淡紫，颜料只会糊开。验血同时报告「潜图」携因。

forgery.name: 伪图
forgery.prompt: a painted violet line pattern on the left side of the neck that looks slightly smudged, like cosmetic ink
forgery.tell: 颈侧纹路有晕开的墨边

ashbanner.decline: 烬图王死于陆桥，灰座空悬百年；王族的因散入民间，只剩「潜图」。
ashbanner.revival: 任何携因者立下大功（伯爵或旗誓）即可觉醒，获议会公推——灰旗家传的旗嗣印，就是半张河图。

marriage.desc: 与觉醒者或旗帅联姻：灰烬邦与陆桥邦交上升；议会把联姻视作站队。

ashbanner.regalia: a slim grey-violet banner pin of the Ash Seat at the collar

shuoying.name: 朔影国

succession.name: 全朔为尊
succession.desc: 全朔者先于一切弦朔者，与长幼无关；同阶以年长者先。

crisis.younger_full_desc: 年幼的全朔者越过年长的弦朔者，长兄长姐不服。
crisis.contested_desc: 两位全朔者年岁相仿，夜阙廷臣各自掌灯。

edge.name: 弦外
edge.desc: 有朔血而眼无银弦者，夜阙不认，只能做侍从；求娶朔氏须多一档邦交。

verify.name: 暗室验瞳
verify.desc: 祠堂熄灯验瞳：真朔环在全暗中微亮，琉璃镜片不亮。

forgery.name: 画瞳
forgery.prompt: eyes with a faint glassy contact-lens rim catching the light

shuoying.decline: 夜禁婚令只许夜阙内通婚，全朔一代比一代少；外血反成解药。
shuoying.revival: 两位弦朔者成婚，四子之中就可能生出一位全朔——灰旗若与朔氏结亲，宿仇可解。

marriage.desc: 与朔氏或夜阙卿联姻能缓和世仇（朔影邦交大涨），但陆桥议会会不安。

shuoying.regalia: a black-glass crescent collar pin of the Night Palace

qinghe.name: 清河国

succession.name: 牒序
succession.desc: 书院按玉值排序：玉值最高的澜氏承牒；玉泽者可入牒但无座。

crisis.contested_desc: 两位承牒人玉值相差不到 0.03，书院开牒议，各派抄手连夜改谱。
crisis.forged_desc: 有人在玉牒上做了手脚：玉缕与血谱对不上。

edge.name: 牒外
edge.desc: 有澜氏血而无玉泽者被称牒外，不得任官；求娶玉牒中人须多一档邦交。

verify.name: 牒验
verify.desc: 书院对谱、祠堂看根：真玉缕从发根就通透，染出来的发根发黑。

forgery.name: 染缕
forgery.prompt: a dyed green lock of hair with darker dye-stained roots

qinghe.decline: 牒外通婚把玉值拉回平均，王族日渐只剩玉泽。
qinghe.revival: 偶尔会出现「玉缕返照」：低牒家庭生出玉缕——须过书院牒议才算数。

marriage.desc: 清河看重谱牒：与河卫或澜氏联姻抬升清河邦交；入牒须付入牒礼（规划中）。

qinghe.regalia: a slim jade register tablet pendant

lantern.name: 灯市联
lantern.motto: 人人有血统，只好比谁更有钱

succession.name: 灯会竞座
succession.desc: 每七年，所有灯丝者竞价灯座；以身家（爵位×10＋等级）为代理排序。

crisis.crowded_desc: 三位以上灯丝者同时出价，商行站队，港口罢市。
crisis.bankrupt_desc: 座主破产，灯座无主，熄灯裔趁乱回港。

edge.desc: 灯市只认钱：有王血而无灯丝，照样做生意，没有污名。

verify.name: 灯验
verify.desc: 在祠堂霜灯下看发梢：真灯丝折出光谱，琉璃纤维接发只有一道白光，还能看到接缝。

forgery.name: 假灯丝
forgery.prompt: glass-fibre hair extensions clipped onto the hair ends, a visible clip seam

lantern.decline: 显性让灯丝泛滥，灯座越来越不值钱。
lantern.revival: 琉氏推「纯灯婚」：只娶双份灯丝者，让子嗣百分百显灯丝。

marriage.desc: 娶灯丝者或琉商：灯市邦交上升，并附嫁妆（嫁妆比血重）。

lantern.regalia: a clear lamp-glass collar chain of the Lamp Seat

paper.name: 纸冕
paper.desc: 灯市出售「灯籍」：花银即得男爵或伯爵名分，戴灯籍徽，但没有灯丝。霜冕、清河、朔影的贵胤拒绝与纸冕者联姻。
paper.prompt: a newly minted clear lamp-glass patent pin, almost too pristine

frostcrown.name: 霜冕廷

succession.name: 冰钟默选
succession.desc: 廷议在霜睫者中静默推举：意志最坚者先，同等以年长者先。

crisis.vacant_desc: 无一人显霜睫：摄霜理政，廷议等待隐性复现。
crisis.contested_desc: 两位霜睫者意志相当，冰钟两边同时敲响。

edge.name: 薄霜
edge.desc: 有霜冕血而睫上无霜者称薄霜，不得入霜阙；求娶霜冕须多一档邦交。

verify.name: 呵气验睫
verify.desc: 祠堂以暖气呵睫：敷霜的妆粉会化，天生霜睫不变；验血同时开出「携霜」契。

forgery.name: 敷霜
forgery.prompt: white cosmetic powder clumped on the eyelashes

frostcrown.decline: 隐性加上小朝廷：霜睫只会越来越少。
frostcrown.revival: 在流亡支和外邦里寻找携因者，以祠堂「携霜」契为聘；两位携者联姻，四子中可能复现一位。

marriage.desc: 霜冕只与携因者谈婚（规划：须携霜契）；结亲提升霜冕邦交。

frostcrown.regalia: an ice-glass bell clasp at the throat

emberold.name: 余烬旧邦

succession.name: 旧典承窑
succession.desc: 冰裂之子按长幼承窑，女儿不承。新典派主张窑女亦可承座。

crisis.cold_desc: 没有一个冰裂之子：窑冕断绝，烬议摄政。
crisis.canon_desc: 冰裂之子缺席，窑女在场：旧典派与新典派对峙。
crisis.false_father_desc: 冰裂之子的父亲没有冰裂——血统与婚约必有一假。

edge.name: 冷灰
edge.desc: 窑女所出之子有窑冕血而无冰裂，旧典派讥为冷灰，新典派视为同胞。

verify.name: 温瓷验纹
verify.desc: 以温热的瓷片贴颊：真冰裂遇热透出瓷光，描上去的釉线不亮；验血同时核对父系。

forgery.name: 描釉
forgery.prompt: thin painted crackle lines on the temple, slightly too regular to be natural

emberold.decline: 末代窑王只有女儿，窑冕被视作断绝。
emberold.revival: 流亡在外的冰裂之子是唯一火种：若灰旗之中有冰裂男子生子，窑冕便归于灰旗。

marriage.desc: 与烬议贵胤联姻提升旧邦邦交；冰裂男子入赘会让旧典派震动。

saltmarsh.name: 盐泽盟

succession.name: 潮法传女
succession.desc: 潮痕之女按长幼承座；潮痕男子称潮伯，只掌兵、不承座。

crisis.many_daughters_desc: 同一位潮伯的几个潮痕女儿出自不同母亲，盐引诸家各押一位。
crisis.vacant_desc: 没有潮痕之女：盐引世家共治，等待潮回。

edge.name: 退潮
edge.desc: 潮痕男子的儿子承不到 X 上的潮痕，称退潮子；能做潮伯幕僚，难入盐后之门。

verify.name: 卤水验发
verify.desc: 以卤水浸发：真潮痕不褪，漂白的盐线会走色；验血同时核对父母——无潮痕父母生不出潮痕女儿。

forgery.name: 盐染
forgery.prompt: bleached pale bands in the hair with uneven chemical edges
forgery.tell: 发环边缘有漂染的毛边

saltmarsh.decline: 女王只生儿子时，潮痕看似中断。
saltmarsh.revival: 潮回：潮痕之子虽不能承座，却把潮痕全部传给他的女儿——王座隔一代跳回来。

marriage.desc: 盐泽婚俗从母居，以盐引为聘（规划中）；联姻提升盐泽邦交。

irongorge.name: 铁峡领

succession.name: 锻选
succession.desc: 所有经祠堂验明的携因者——显峡眉或藏钢——皆可入锻场；力＋体＋等级最高者胜。

crisis.hidden_top_desc: 锻选头名是一位眉形完整的藏钢，显峡眉的旧族不服。
crisis.contested_desc: 三层城区的人选旗鼓相当，吊桥封锁。

edge.name: 无刻
edge.desc: 铁峡只看锻场：有峡钢血而无峡眉，验明携因照样能比。

verify.name: 斋月验眉
verify.desc: 祠堂留人三十日：剃出来的眉隙会长回，天生峡眉不会；验血可直接看出藏钢。

forgery.name: 剃眉
forgery.prompt: freshly shaved gaps in the eyebrows with faint regrowing stubble
forgery.tell: 眉隙里有新长的胡茬状短毛

irongorge.decline: 峡座从不衰落，只是能争的人太多，锻选越来越频繁。
irongorge.revival: 藏钢之家一旦被祠堂验明，就能把一个铁匠的儿子送进锻场。

marriage.desc: 与峡卫或锻氏联姻提升铁峡邦交，常以铁料为嫁妆（规划中）。

irongorge.regalia: a cold-steel collar ring of the forge seat

starriver.name: 星津邦

succession.name: 双虹合璧
succession.desc: 唯七星者可登星枢；观象台以感知与意志排序。

crisis.vacant_desc: 无一位七星：两虹之一凋零或断交，观象台摄政。
crisis.contested_desc: 两位七星者感知与意志相当，观象台夜夜重算星位。

edge.name: 残星
edge.desc: 有七星血而痣不成形者称残星，可入观象台为吏，不登星枢。

verify.name: 星验
verify.desc: 观象台以标准星图比对痣位：点出来的痣间距总有偏差；验血同时报告三台/四辅携因。

forgery.name: 点痣
forgery.prompt: small inked dots on the cheek arranged slightly off-pattern

starriver.decline: 两虹任一凋零，七星便无从出生。
starriver.revival: 撮合三台与四辅之家：两人各携一种，孩子就能合成七星。

marriage.desc: 星津亲善：与东虹或西虹联姻提升星津邦交，撮合两虹婚约会被观象台记功。

southzephyr.name: 南泽邦

succession.name: 萤母议
succession.desc: 萤光最亮的萤之女承母议；萤子（男）不承。

crisis.vacant_desc: 萤母一脉的女儿萤值全部跌破门槛：这一支永远失去席位。
crisis.contested_desc: 两位萤之女同样明亮，雾林分成两岸。

edge.name: 熄萤
edge.desc: 萤子之子有萤母血而无萤光：血统写着王族，脸上一片黑暗。

verify.name: 雨验
verify.desc: 祠堂以雨水洗面、熄灯观光：磷粉一洗就花，真萤斑在暗处更亮；验血同时核对母系。

forgery.name: 磷粉
forgery.prompt: specks of glowing powder dusted on the nose that smear at the edges
forgery.tell: 鼻梁上的光点边缘晕开

southzephyr.decline: 萤值随母系漂移，一旦跌破门槛就不再回升。
southzephyr.revival: 萤燃：漂移偶尔向上，一位渡灯家的女儿也可能越过门槛，被萤母议接纳。

marriage.desc: 萤母难得外嫁（规划：须萤约，一位孙女归林）；娶萤母之女，子女皆承萤光。

landbridge.name: 朔澜陆桥
landbridge.desc: 陆桥是十国商路的十字口：酒馆里东西两陆的民胤混坐，流裔最多，没有王座。

diaspora.name: 萤子
diaspora.desc: 萤母之子：生而带萤斑，却注定无法传下。他们离林渡水，成了四方最常见的王血佣兵。

diaspora.name: 窑冕流裔
diaspora.desc: 三代前被逐出焚阙的幼子一支。血统只剩两成五，脸上的冰裂却一分不少——Y 不会被稀释。

diaspora.name: 潮伯
diaspora.desc: 潮痕男子不能承座，便出海、从军、做佣兵。他们的女儿才是盐后真正的候选。

diaspora.name: 离潮支
diaspora.desc: 盐战中落败的一支盐后后裔，在南泽渡口隐居。

diaspora.name: 烬图流裔
diaspora.desc: 灰座空悬后散入驿城的烬图旁支：多半携着潜图，自己却不知道。

diaspora.name: 影裔
diaspora.desc: 夜阙清洗中逃出的弦朔者，在港口做斥候和刺客。

diaspora.name: 雪逐支
diaspora.desc: 被逐出霜阙的廷卿后人，替朔影带路、替铁峡守矿，暗中携着霜睫之因。

diaspora.name: 澜氏旁支
diaspora.desc: 因改牒丑闻被除名的澜氏一支，在盐泽做盐引公证人；牒外三代，只剩玉泽。

diaspora.name: 坠星支
diaspora.desc: 政变后流亡的七星王子后裔，在清河书院做学者佣兵。

diaspora.name: 熄灯裔
diaspora.desc: 破产灯主的后人：发梢仍是灯丝，钱袋却空了，在外岛做船匪或护航。

diaspora.name: 断桥裔
diaspora.desc: 历次锻选的败者被逐下底层城区，许多人带着藏钢四处卖刀。

lines.name: 烬图王胤
lines.desc: 灰座旧王之血。河图之因显性，却要立下功勋才在颈侧显纹。
lines.lore: 百年前最后一位烬图王死在陆桥。灰座空了一百年，河图之因散进了平原的血里，等某个立下大功的人重新把它烧亮。
lines.look: Ashbanner styling: ash-grey long coat with a high open collar

lines.name: 旗帅贵胤
lines.desc: 城堡群的旗帅世家，烬图王的将门之后。颈侧常有一道淡淡的旗痕。
lines.lore: 旗帅们在灰座空悬的百年里替议会守城。他们的旗痕只是河图的主干，没有支流——这是将门，不是王门。
lines.look: Ashbanner marshal styling: structured ash-grey officer coat with a tall collar and a slim grey-violet sash

lines.name: 灰烬民胤
lines.desc: 陆桥边民血脉，坚韧务实。少数人身上睡着半张河图。
lines.lore: 佣兵与商队是灰烬邦的血液。平原上的老人说，烬图王的血早就流进了每一条田埂。
lines.look: Ashbanner borderfolk styling: practical ash-grey layered technical jacket with a slim grey-violet scarf

lines.name: 朔望王胤
lines.desc: 夜阙王族。两份朔因显全朔瞳：瞳孔外一圈细银环，像日全食。
lines.lore: 朔氏只在入夜后开廷，因为全朔瞳在暗处会微微发亮。眼睛不会说谎，所以这座宫廷什么都不信，只信眼睛。
lines.look: Shuoying night-court styling: midnight-indigo high collar with fine silver piping

lines.name: 夜阙贵胤
lines.desc: 夜阙廷臣，多是一份朔因的弦朔瞳——瞳缘上一弯银弦。
lines.lore: 每一位夜阙卿都是王座的远亲：两位弦朔者成婚，四个孩子里就可能有一个全朔。朔影的多疑，就是从这里来的。
lines.look: Shuoying night-court styling: high indigo collar with a small black-glass crescent pin

lines.name: 霜脊民胤
lines.desc: 北境霜脊的山民，瘦高、肤冷、目深。
lines.lore: 霜脊人替夜阙守关，也替夜阙保守秘密。偶尔有山民的孩子眼里出现一弯银弦，那家人便会被请进宫里，再也不回来。
lines.look: Shuoying ridge styling: deep indigo hooded technical coat with frost-dusted shoulders

lines.name: 玉牒王胤
lines.desc: 玉牒在册的澜氏。玉值越过门槛，左鬓便生一缕通透的玉色发。
lines.lore: 澜氏的玉缕不是单一的因，而是许多细小血脉叠起来的「玉值」。书院替王族记谱、算婚，牒外的一次通婚就能让下一代失去玉缕。
lines.look: Qinghe register styling: layered jade-grey and mist-white silk with a high mandarin collar

lines.name: 河卫血胤
lines.desc: 朔澜河岸守望者后裔，掌渡口，敏于行。玉值高者发间有玉泽。
lines.lore: 河卫世家握着清河所有的渡口。王座是玉做的，渡口却是铁做的——真正的权力在船上。
lines.look: Qinghe ferry-ward styling: jade-grey high-collared coat with a slim ferry-token pendant

lines.name: 汀洲民胤
lines.desc: 三角洲与雾中果林的人家，面容柔和，手上常带染坊的靛色。
lines.lore: 汀洲人替书院抄谱，替染坊调色。染坊也是清河最大的伪造作坊——一缕染出来的玉色发，足够骗过半个酒馆。
lines.look: Qinghe delta styling: mist-grey technical silk with indigo dye-stained cuffs

lines.name: 灯冕王胤
lines.desc: 灯座之血。一份灯丝因即显：发梢化作琉璃纤丝，末端微亮。
lines.lore: 灯丝因太容易传下去了，港口里满是有灯丝的人。于是灯座每七年拍卖一次——人人有血统，只好比谁更有钱。
lines.look: Lantern League styling: tailored night-market coat with a clear glass collar bar

lines.name: 琉商贵胤
lines.desc: 琉璃商行世家。发梢一抹琉光，是与灯座通婚留下的小征。
lines.lore: 琉商们发明了「灯籍」：花钱就能买一个贵胄名分。所以在灯市，最不值钱的就是头衔。
lines.look: Lantern merchant styling: fitted slate coat with a row of clear lamp-glass buttons

lines.name: 潮灯民胤
lines.desc: 群岛水手与夜市人家，肤色铜亮，颧骨清晰。
lines.lore: 夜市的价一夜三变。潮灯人什么都卖，包括别人的血统——假灯丝在这里是一门手艺。
lines.look: Lantern League harbor styling: waterproof slate harbor coat with small lamp-glass beads at the collar

lines.name: 霜冕王胤
lines.desc: 稀有王系残脉，六维上限极高。双份霜睫因方显：睫毛与眉梢天生霜白。
lines.lore: 霜冕廷只在携因者之间联姻，王胤一代比一代稀薄。冰钟每响一次，廷议就多等一年：等一个睫上带霜的孩子出生。
lines.look: Frostcrown court styling: frost-white and pale slate layered robe-coat

lines.name: 霜阙贵胤
lines.desc: 霜阙廷卿。眉梢一点天生的霜白；许多人暗中携着霜睫之因。
lines.lore: 廷卿们彼此通婚，只为把隐性的霜睫留在宫里。祠堂开出的「携霜」验契，是霜冕廷最硬的聘礼。
lines.look: Frostcrown hall styling: frost-white high coat with an ice-glass clasp

lines.name: 高原民胤
lines.desc: 高原牧户与冰匠，双颊被风吹红，身量高直。
lines.lore: 高原人不谈王族，但每个村子都记得哪家祖上出过「睫上霜」的孩子。
lines.look: Frostcrown plateau styling: layered frost-white felt with ice-glass toggles

lines.name: 窑冕王胤
lines.desc: 旧邦窑王之血。冰裂纹只随父系传给儿子，女儿永不承。
lines.lore: 末代窑王只有女儿，窑火就此冷了。旧典派说窑冕已绝；可三代前被逐出焚阙的那支幼子后裔，还有人脸上带着冰裂。
lines.look: Emberold old-canon styling: charcoal high coat with celadon porcelain toggles

lines.name: 余烬贵胤
lines.desc: 旧邦余烬贵族，力与意偏高。烬纹不完全显性，一份便淡淡可见。
lines.lore: 窑王绝嗣后，烬议诸家接管了旧邦。他们最怕的不是外敌，而是某个脸上带冰裂的流亡者回来。
lines.look: Emberold council styling: charcoal coat with porcelain-white piping

lines.name: 窑原民胤
lines.desc: 窑镇与废墟掘客，橄榄肤色，颧高眉重。
lines.lore: 窑原人在废墟里挖最好的料，也挖旧王的秘密。他们说：冰裂会骗人，描上去的釉线遇热不亮。
lines.look: Emberold kiln-town styling: heat-proof ceramic-fibre apron over a charcoal work coat with porcelain toggles

lines.name: 潮后王胤
lines.desc: 盐后之血。潮痕发随 X 显性而行：潮痕之父传全部女儿，不传儿子。
lines.lore: 盐泽由女王治理。潮痕男子只能做「潮伯」掌兵，他们的潮痕会全部落到女儿身上——所以每位潮伯的女儿，都是潜在的女王。
lines.look: Saltmarsh tide-court styling: pale slate and salt-white layered coat

lines.name: 盐引贵胤
lines.desc: 握盐引的世家。发间一道淡淡的盐线，同样随 X 而行。
lines.lore: 盐引就是盐泽的货币，盐引世家就是盐泽的银行。她们嫁女儿时不收聘礼，只收盐引。
lines.look: Saltmarsh ledger-house styling: pale slate coat with a thin salt-crystal chain

lines.name: 芦滩民胤
lines.desc: 潮滩盐工，肤色晒成铜色，身板结实。
lines.lore: 潮汐即法度。芦滩人按潮水作息，也按潮水分家：家产随女儿走，儿子随船走。
lines.look: Saltmarsh reed styling: reed-weave cape over a waterproof jacket with salt-crystal toggles

lines.name: 峡钢王胤
lines.desc: 峡座之血。峡眉因显性，却只有六成携者眉被劈开；其余是「藏钢」。
lines.lore: 峡座从不世袭，只靠锻选：凡祠堂验明的携因者——显也好、藏也好——都能进锻场。所以铁峡从不缺王，只缺安宁。
lines.look: Iron Gorge forge-lord styling: dark steel-grey coat with a cold-steel collar ring

lines.name: 峡卫贵胤
lines.desc: 守三层吊桥的峡卫世家。眉尾常有一道天生的眉刻。
lines.lore: 峡卫替锻场的胜者守桥，也替败者收尸。每次锻选之后，总有一家峡卫换了主人。
lines.look: Iron Gorge bridge-warden styling: dark steel-grey coat with a riveted gorget

lines.name: 炉峡民胤
lines.desc: 峡谷锻炉的匠户，肤色深，方颌宽肩。
lines.lore: 炉峡人说，钢藏在血里不一定露在脸上。他们的孩子里偶尔会冒出一个「藏钢」，被祠堂一验，便能进锻场。
lines.look: Iron Gorge forge styling: heat-shield leather vest with cold-steel rivets, canyon-dust goggles pushed up on the forehead

lines.name: 七星王胤
lines.desc: 星枢之血。三台与四辅两种小痣在一人身上合成北斗七星痣。
lines.lore: 七星只能由东虹与西虹的结合生出。两座虹桥两家人，世代必须联姻；观象台替星枢验星、记谱，也替它挑婚。
lines.look: Starriver observatory styling: frosted navy high collar

lines.name: 东虹贵胤
lines.desc: 东虹桥世家，携三台：左眼下三颗斜列的小痣。
lines.lore: 东虹家只有三台，永远生不出七星；它需要西虹，就像桥需要对岸。
lines.look: Starriver East Rainbow styling: frosted navy coat with a thin pale arc embroidered across the chest

lines.name: 西虹贵胤
lines.desc: 西虹桥世家，携四辅：左鬓四颗弧列的小痣。
lines.lore: 西虹家记得每一次与东虹的婚约，也记得每一次毁约。孤虹之年，就是两家断交的那些年。
lines.look: Starriver West Rainbow styling: frosted navy coat with a thin pale arc embroidered on the left shoulder

lines.name: 津桥民胤
lines.desc: 渡口与观象台小镇的人家，眉目清秀。
lines.lore: 津桥人最会点痣：观象台门口的画痣摊，一天能卖出半条街的「三台」。
lines.look: Starriver ferry styling: frosted navy high collar embroidered with tiny star-chart dots

lines.name: 萤母王胤
lines.desc: 萤母之血。萤值只经母系：母亲把萤光传给每个孩子，父亲一分不传。
lines.lore: 南泽由萤母议治理。萤母的儿子也会发光，却永远传不下去——这些「萤子」离林渡水，成了四方最常见的王血佣兵。
lines.look: South Zephyr matriarch styling: layered rain-cape of beeswaxed cloth with carved hardwood beads

lines.name: 渡灯贵胤
lines.desc: 掌渡口灯火的氏族。萤值中等，鼻梁上几点淡萤。
lines.lore: 渡灯家的女儿若嫁给萤母之子，孩子只会承她自己的那点微光。南泽人都懂：要光，得娶萤母的女儿。
lines.look: South Zephyr ferry styling: oiled rain jacket with a small ferry-lamp pendant

lines.name: 雾林民胤
lines.desc: 萤雾森林的养蜂人与伐木人，肤色深暖，发卷而密。
lines.lore: 雾林人养蜂、伐硬木、种南椒。他们也卖磷粉——抹在鼻梁上，夜里看着就像萤斑，下一场雨就花了。
lines.look: South Zephyr fog-forest styling: beeswax-coated rain cape and carved hardwood beads, tight dark curls
